test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

Mosquito means small fly. It has a transmitter segmented body and a _______________ of wings. Male mosquitoes mainly feed on plant _______________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"pair"** means two corresponding or similar items that are used together. (जोड़ा)

 
 
• **Example: **She bought a new pair of shoes for the party.
 
 
 
• **"Nectar" **refers to a sweet liquid secreted by flowers to attract pollinating insects and birds. (मधु)
 
 
• **Example: **Bees collect nectar from flowers to make honey.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that a mosquito is a little fly. It has two wings and a transmitter-segmented body. The primary food source for male mosquitoes is plant juice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **pair; nectar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Kind **(प्रकार): A group of people or things having similar characteristics.

 
 
• **Example:** She is the kind of person who helps everyone.
 
 
 
• **Drink **(पेय ): A liquid that can be swallowed as refreshment or nourishment.
 
 
• **Example: **Water is the healthiest drink.
 
 
 
• **Set **(समूह): A collection of objects considered as a unit.
 
 
• **Example:** She has a set of fine china.
 
 
 
• **Beverage **(पेय पदार्थ): Any type of drink except water.
 
 
• **Example:** Coffee is a popular morning beverage.
 
 
 
• **Couple **(जोड़ा): Two people or things of the same sort considered together.
 
 
• **Example:** The couple went on a vacation together.
 
 
 
• **Liquor **(शराब): Alcoholic drink, especially distilled spirits.
 
 
• **Example:** He prefers liquor over beer.
 
 

17a:T4be,
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.</p&
